mapper.insert: INSERT INTO leave_request (approval_id, leave_type, start_date, end_date, days, reason) VALUES (#{approvalId}, #{leaveType}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{days}, #{reason}) ON CONFLICT (approval_id) DO UPDATE SET leave_type = EXCLUDED.leave_type, start_date = EXCLUDED.start_date, end_date = EXCLUDED.end_date, days = EXCLUDED.days, reason = EXCLUDED.reason
